decision_notes: The official institutional explanation establishes lawmaking, public finance and executive accountability. British Overseas Territory; separate BM map parent and UK search association.

The official Parliament homepage designates the Sliq Harmony service for listening. Public archive recordings of Senate AM 7 October 2026 and House PM 2 October 2026 both passed advancing audio playback in WebKit. Chromium fails to load the same media manifest with a CORS error; the service has a browser compatibility limitation. Audio archive only; on-air live coverage and video were not validated.
Added after WebKit playback resolved the earlier Chromium-only failure assessment, with local flag, localized name, map, UK search and planned calendar link.
